# RNS Construction

> RNS Construction is a construction business based in Mohali, Punjab, serving Mohali, Chandigarh, Zirakpur and nearby areas. Its public website covers house construction, turnkey projects, architectural planning, interiors and renovation.

This is a short directory of the business's public website. Published package rates are scope-specific references, not a fixed quotation for every project. Construction-progress photographs are not evidence that a house is complete.

## Business and services

- [RNS Construction](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/): Business overview, services, project photographs and enquiry options.
- [About RNS](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/about.html): Business background and service areas.
- [Construction services](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/services.html): Overview of residential, commercial, design, interior and renovation services.
- [House construction](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/services-house-construction.html): Residential scope, typical specifications and quotation information.
- [Turnkey projects](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/services-turnkey-projects.html): Design, construction and interior work brought together for a project.

## Questions and budget planning

- [Construction questions](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/construction-questions-mohali.html): Answers about cost, approvals, scope, documents and project timelines.
- [Construction cost per square foot in Punjab](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/construction-cost-per-sq-ft-punjab.html): How to compare measurement, materials and scope; published RNS rates are not a Punjab-wide market average.
- [Construction cost calculator](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/calculator.html): Estimate using area, floor count and a visitor-entered construction rate.

## Project evidence

- [Zirakpur house at plaster stage](https://rnsconstructionmohali.com/zirakpur-house-plaster-construction.html): Actual photographs of a house under construction, not a completed-home or handover claim.
